question.html:
A transverse wave is traveling in a medium from left to right. The graph shows how d, the displacement of the particles in the medium varies with x, the distance. The solid line shows the displacement at t = 0 and the dashed line shows the displacement at t = 0.032 s.

a. Distinguish between a transverse and a longitudinal traveling wave.

  [2]

b. State the amplitude of the wave.

  [1]

c. Show that the speed of the wave is 0.23 m s.

  [2]

d. Calculate the frequency of the wave.

  [2]

e. The point labelled with the letter A represents a particle in the medium in which the wave travels. On the diagram, draw an arrow to represent the direction of motion of this particle at t = 0.

  [1]
